title: A flaw in Node.js DNS resolution allows hostnames containing a NUL byte to be silently truncated by the dns.resolve*()…
description: A vulnerability in Node.js DNS resolution allows hostnames containing a NUL byte to be silently truncated by the dns.resolve*() functions. This flaw affects version 3.0 of the affected Microsoft product. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. There is no indication of known exploits in the wild or available patches at this time.
